name: pi-ouranos-modes
description: Mode-aware agent orchestration for Pi. Ships default/plan/build/orchestrator modes; manages activeMode in a local-only .modes-state.json (not synced across machines), injects per-mode delegation policy prompts, and remembers the last-selected model + thinking level per mode (modePrefs in settings.json — synced). Replaces pi-modes.
author: Ben
